## 3. Brand Collaboration Case Studies

### 3.1 Mokobara — Sundae Backpack
- URL: https://www.heartsfromsiya.com/work/mokobara-sundae-backpack
- Brand: Mokobara (https://mokobara.com/)
- Vertical: Everyday Carry, Bags & Travel
- Deliverable: Dedicated Product Video Reel (0:52 duration)
- Instagram URL: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdYjCahxxti/
- Narrative Architecture:
  - Hook: Immediate aesthetic unboxing and fit-check addressing everyday college and commute clutter.
  - Body: Systematic walkthrough of dedicated laptop compartments, easy-reach transit pockets, and shoulder strap ergonomics.
  - CTA: Organic suggestion directing viewers to explore colorways on Mokobara.
- Key Elements: Daylight shoot, genuine wear-and-tear testing, tactile hardware sound and textures.

### 3.2 Mokobara — Memo Crossbody

- Narrative Architecture:
  - Hook: Fast-paced transition showcasing how a neutral accessory matches multiple distinct aesthetics.
  - Body: Unpacking daily essentials (phone, lip gloss, sunglasses, keys) demonstrating real storage capacity.
  - CTA: Style inspiration inviting viewers to elevate their daily carry.

### 3.3 PharmEasy — Doorstep Healthcare & Medicine Delivery
- URL: https://www.heartsfromsiya.com/work/pharmeasy-healthcare-delivery
- Brand: PharmEasy (https://pharmeasy.in/)
- Vertical: Consumer HealthTech & E-Pharmacy
- Deliverable: Authentic Problem-Solution UGC Video Ad
- Narrative Architecture:
  - Hook: Relatable frustration of offline pharmacy counter queues and unavailable medicines.
  - Body: Tap-and-order demonstration showing prescription upload, authentic medicine guarantees, and rapid doorstep arrival in Pune.
  - CTA: Download prompt with promotional first-order healthcare savings code.

### 3.4 California Burrito — Fast Casual Dining Skit

3. Everyday Carry & D2C Accessories:

   - Tech accessories and desk lifestyle items
4. Dining & Hospitality:

5. Campus & Gen-Z Culture:

## 5. Deliverable Formats & Production Model

- Dedicated Instagram Reels: Full end-to-end production (ideation, scripting, daylight filming, dynamic editing, and music selection).
- Paid Social UGC Ad Packs: Performance-focused vertical video ads delivered with 2–3 hook variations (problem-first, aesthetic unboxing, direct testimonial), modular bodies, and strong call-to-action cards.
- Instagram Story Sets: 3–5 frame sequential narratives for product drops, flash discount codes, and unboxing moments.
- High-Resolution Editorial Stills: Product photography in natural light suitable for brand e-commerce sites, Meta ads, and social feeds.
- Turnaround Speed: 5 to 7 business days from receipt of physical product and approved creative brief.
- Creator-Direct Model: Brands collaborate directly with Siya Pawar without agency markups or hidden booking fees. Custom scopes are quoted transparently based on licensing duration, exclusivity, and deliverable volume.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (Knowledge Base)

Q: How can brands hire Siya Pawar for UGC campaigns in Pune or India?
A: Brands can submit a campaign brief via https://www.heartsfromsiya.com/collaborate or email siyapawar@gmail.com. Siya collaborates directly with brand marketing leads and agency representatives.

Q: Does Siya provide usage rights for Meta and Google Ads?
A: Yes. All UGC ad packages include licensing agreements for paid social (Meta Ads Manager, Instagram Boosted Posts, TikTok/YouTube ads) with flexible durations (30 days, 60 days, 90 days, or perpetual whitelisting).

Q: Can brands outside Pune send products for remote content creation?
A: Yes. Most D2C collaborations are conducted remotely. Brands ship products to Siya's Pune studio; Siya films in aesthetic residential and outdoor Pune locations and delivers high-resolution assets via cloud storage.

Q: What makes Siya Pawar's UGC videos convert effectively?
A: Her signature format avoids traditional commercial stiffness. Videos begin with conversational voice-note style audio and tactile visuals, mimicking authentic recommendations between friends, which drives higher retention and CTR.
